definitions.explanation: Something that happens without planning or intention.

examples.japanese: {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I happened to meet a friend at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: By coincidence, we were reading the same book.

examples.japanese: {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{必然|ひつぜん}→必然：05533_hitsuzen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なって→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A series of coincidences led to the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会う：02298_deau⟧、⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{思|おも}わず→思わず：02549_omowazu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけてしまった→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: By chance, I ran into an old classmate while traveling, and was so surprised that I couldn't help but call out to them.

notes:
{偶然|ぐうぜん} can function as a noun (coincidence), adverb (by chance), or na-adjective (accidental). It describes events that happen without planning or intention.

AS ADVERB:
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧ (met by chance)
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧ (found by accident)
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜 (by coincidence ~ — adds emphasis)

AS NOUN:
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧ (coincidence)
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧ (coincidences pile up)
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on chance)

AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧ (a chance encounter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}: by chance, accidental
- ⟦{必然|ひつぜん}→必然：05533_hitsuzen⟧: inevitable, necessary (direct antonym)
- ⟦たまたま→偶々：03408_tamatama⟧: by chance, it just happened that (more casual, adverb only)
